WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.label: Adaptive Chassis
WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.description: Through biomechanical adaptation, the Absolute Solver's mutation weaves generative algorithms into its chassis, enabling self-optimizing reconfiguration. This living machinery enhances both mobility and structural resilience, evolving in response to environmental demands.
WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.tooltipExtra: Mutation trait for Absolute Solver users. Enhances mobility and durability.

WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.label: Corruption Drain
WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.description: Unlocks a latent protocol that subtly siphons corruption from the system, enhancing operational efficiency by 5%. The process is seamless.
WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.tooltipExtra: Mutation trait for Absolute Solver users. Allows passive corruption drain.

WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.label: corrupt optimization
WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.description: An optimization protocol delivered by the Solver itself. Less heat. More power. All it asks is that you trust it... more than yourself.
WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.tooltipExtra: Corruption trait for Absolute Solver users. Allows less heat gain from abilities but higher corruption gain.

WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.label: solar veil protocol
WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.description: Reduces heat from sunlight by bending rays away, but increases corruption gain. A forbidden Solver adaptation.
WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.tooltipExtra: Corruption trait for Absolute Solver users. Allows less heat gain from Sunlight but higher corruption gain from abilities.

WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.label: accelerated protocol
WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.description: Unlocks advanced Solver routines that reduce ability cooldowns by 10%. Actions flow seamlessly, enabling rapid tactical responses.
WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.tooltipExtra: Manipulation trait for Absolute Solver users. Abilities recharge faster.

WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.label: thermal efficiency
WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.description: Solver-driven optimizations lower heat gain from abilities by 5%. The system remains cooler, sustaining manipulation protocols longer.
WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.tooltipExtra: Manipulation trait for Absolute Solver users. Slightly reduces heat gain from abilities.

WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.label: Greg
WorkerDronesMod.SolverTraitDef.tooltipExtra: This is a test trait for debugging purposes.
